name: rail
description: A docked side panel for Claude, Notion and Fireflies on macOS.

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && RAIL_DEV_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.install-app: npm run dist && rm -rf /Applications/Rail.app && cp -R release/mac-arm64/Rail.app /Applications/ && open /Applications/Rail.app

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Claude voice input, and Notion meeting transcription when you start it from Rail.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used only if a pane asks for the camera.
